class.name: NNBlackboard
class.brief_description: A typed key/value store used as the behaviour tree and state tree blackboard.
class.description: [NNBlackboard] stores values in a typed [Dictionary] with [String] keys and [Variant] values. It is the effective blackboard for the [NNBTNodes] and [NNSTBranchNodes] blackboard helpers and the world state of an [NNHTNRoot], either assigned to an [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot] or [NNHTNRoot] through its [code]blackboard[/code] property, or created privately by that root. [code]resource_local_to_scene[/code] defaults to [code]true[/code] for every [NNBlackboard]. When a board is embedded in a scene or assigned in the inspector, each scene instance gets its own copy of it. Untick [code]resource_local_to_scene[/code] deliberately to share one board across all instances of the scene. A key whose stored value is [code]null[/code] counts as absent for [method has_value] and [method get_value], but the key is still reported by [method keys] and is removed normally by [method erase_value] and [method clear]. [signal value_changed] is emitted exactly once per actual change. Setting a value that is already stored emits nothing. [signal value_erased] is only emitted when an existing key is erased, and [signal cleared] only when the dictionary was non-empty. [method get_debug_data] returns a copy in which every [Object] value is replaced by its class name (or [code]<null>[/code]) and nested [Array] and [Dictionary] values are sanitised recursively, so the result never contains a raw [Object]. Values nested deeper than 16 levels are replaced by [code]<max depth>[/code], so cyclic or very deeply nested containers cannot recurse indefinitely. An optional [member schema] type-checks writes. [method set_value], [method set_values] and [method apply_values] report an error and change nothing when the schema rejects a value. Writing [code]null[/code] is always allowed, and [method erase_value] and [method clear] are never restricted.

method.name: apply_values
method.description: Merges [param values] into the blackboard as one transaction. Every entry is checked first: when any key is not a non-empty [String] or the [member schema] rejects any value, an error is reported, nothing is written, no signal is emitted and [code]false[/code] is returned. Otherwise entries whose value is already stored are skipped, the rest are written, and only then [signal value_changed] is emitted once per written key, in [param values] order, so listeners always observe the whole batch. Keys not in [param values] are left untouched. Returns [code]true[/code] when the batch was accepted, including when every value was already stored.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every key. Emits [signal cleared] only when the blackboard was non-empty.

method.name: erase_value
method.description: Erases [param key], including a key whose stored value is [code]null[/code], and emits [signal value_erased]. Returns [code]false[/code] and emits nothing when the key does not exist.

method.name: get_debug_data
method.description: Returns a shallow copy of the blackboard for debugging. Every [Object] value is replaced by a [String] containing its class name, with a null object replaced by [code]<null>[/code]. Nested [Array] and [Dictionary] values are sanitised recursively, so the result contains no raw [Object] values. Values nested deeper than 16 levels are replaced by [code]<max depth>[/code], which bounds cyclic and very deep structures.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the stored value for [param key]. Returns [param default_value] when the key does not exist or when its stored value is [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only when [param key] exists and its stored value is not [code]null[/code].

method.name: keys
method.description: Returns every stored key, including keys whose value is [code]null[/code].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] and emits [signal value_changed]. Returns [code]false[/code] and does nothing when [param key] is empty or when the [member schema] rejects [param value], which also reports an error. When the same value is already stored, nothing is written and no signal is emitted, but the call still returns [code]true[/code].

members.member: Optional typed key declarations that every write is checked against. [code]null[/code] removes all constraints. Attaching a schema first validates it with [method NNBlackboardSchema.get_validation_errors] and checks every stored value with [method NNBlackboardSchema.accepts]. If either fails, an error is reported and the previous schema is kept. On success, the schema's defaults are installed for keys that are absent (missing or [code]null[/code]); stored values are never overwritten. Installing defaults does not emit [signal value_changed]: like assigning [member values], it sets up the board's contents rather than recording a change. [method erase_value] and [method clear] remove defaulted keys like any other. The schema is shared, not copied, when the board is duplicated for [member Resource.resource_local_to_scene].

The typed key/value store. Keys are always [String]s and values are [Variant]s. Assigning a dictionary replaces the stored values: non-[String] keys are rejected with an engine error and the previous contents are kept. When a [member schema] is attached, every value is checked first; a rejected value reports an error and keeps the previous contents. After a successful replace, schema defaults are installed silently for absent keys. Emits no signals.

signal.name: cleared
signal.description: Emitted by [method clear] when the blackboard was non-empty.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted exactly once when [param key] is set to a new or changed value. Setting an equal value emits nothing. Rejected writes, [member values] assignments and installed schema defaults never emit it.

signal.name: value_erased
signal.description: Emitted by [method erase_value] when an existing [param key] was erased.
